subject: [RFC PATCH 1/7] memcg: add helpers to handle memory.high overage in long operations

2026-11-22.patch_summary: This patch adds two new helpers to the Linux kernel's memory control group (memcg) subsystem: `mem_cgroup_over_high_pending()` and `mem_cgroup_over_high_throttle()`. The first helper checks if a task has more than a batch of memory.high or swap.high overage pending, while the second helper handles this overage by reclaiming memory and sleeping. These helpers are designed for operations that can charge a lot in one call, allowing them to handle overages without blocking other tasks. The patch also exports `__mem_cgroup_handle_over_high()` for filesystems built as modules.
